codeSteps.explanation: `findSums` builds the sum of the first `k` elements. If that window already exceeds `B`, length `k` is infeasible.

codeSteps.title: Slide the fixed-size window
codeSteps.explanation: For each next position, subtract the element leaving the window and add the element entering it. Reject as soon as any length-`k` window exceeds `B`.

codeSteps.title: Shrink after an infeasible midpoint
codeSteps.explanation: When any window violates the sum limit, move `hi` left. `ans` retains the largest feasible length found so far.
